d:
Oman men khele gae andar 19 eshiya kap ke fainal men jit ke bad bhartiy tim ke jashn manane ke tariqe par soshal midiya par kafi bahas ho rahi hai. kuchh log bhartiy tim ke khilariyon ka samarthan kar rahe hain to kuchh logon ka kahna hai ki khel ke maidan men is tarah ke jashn se bachna chahie. khaskar pakistan ke kriket fains, purv kriketar aur eksapart bhartiy tim ke jashn manane ke tariqe par saval khare kar rahe hain.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
